scifact.note: Published zero-shot nDCG@10 on the BEIR SciFact test split, the same queries and corpus the harness runs.

longmemeval-s.note: No comparable published baseline: LongMemEval reports retrieval only for LongMemEval_M, with NDCG@5 and a 1.5B Stella V5 retriever (Wu et al., 2024), and its headline results are question-answering accuracy.

isis-live.note: Written for Isis; no published baseline. Use the history command to compare rounds.

atlas.note: Written for Isis; no published baseline. Use the history command to compare rounds.
